facts.statement: The after-source contract defines MD_FLAG_SPOILERS as 0x10000 and describes paired || delimiters as spoiler spans when that flag is enabled.

evidence.dependency_reason: Declares the spoiler span type and its paired-delimiter syntax.

facts.statement: For inputs at least 2 * sizeof(unsigned) bytes long, the entry takes parser and renderer flags from the first two unsigned values and passes all remaining bytes to md_html. Its parser flag value can therefore contain the MD_FLAG_SPOILERS bit while the remaining bytes contain ||text||.

evidence.dependency_reason: Identifies the flag bit that the input-derived parser flags can carry.

facts.statement: md_html is the entry's primary operation; its declared arguments include input bytes and size, an output callback and userdata, parser flags, and renderer flags.

evidence.dependency_reason: Declares the arguments accepted by the called operation.

facts.statement: The supplied recipe runs CMake with BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF, compiles fuzz-mdhtml.c, and links the fuzz target with libmd4c-html.a and libmd4c.a.
The after-source code includes the spoiler flag in a pipe-related gate and defines an opener stack for pipe marks.

evidence.dependency_reason: Names the stack used for pipe openers.

facts.statement: The after-source pipe analyzer resolves a potential closer against an available pipe opener; resolved two-character pipe marks dispatch MD_SPAN_SPOILER enter or leave callbacks, and the shown leave callback emits </x-spoiler>.

evidence.dependency_reason: Maps resolved paired-pipe marks to spoiler span callbacks.
Shows the HTML closing tag produced for the spoiler span.

facts.statement: The old harness has no fixed parser flag mask: the parser flags come directly from the input, so its input format does not itself block the spoiler flag and paired-delimiter witness at the md_html call.

evidence.dependency_reason: Specifies the spoiler bit available to the input-derived parser flags.

facts.statement: In the complete supplied harness unit, the only input gate is the minimum size check; the output callback returns without inspecting output, and the entry does not check md_html's return value or assert on rendered text.

The complete supplied after-source md_analyze_marks function has no pipe case in its mark-analysis switch. That fact is confined to this function; the supplied pipe analyzer and spoiler dispatch show other pipe-related code.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows a separate pipe analyzer, limiting what can be inferred from the switch.
Shows separate spoiler span dispatch for resolved pipe marks.
